items.question: What is the 3D Studio?
items.answer: An online creative tool to design your own tooth jewellery compositions: choose pieces, place them on a smile and see the result before anything is set.

items.question: What can I create with it?
items.answer: Anything from a single discreet crystal to a full statement composition — mixing shapes, colours, crystals and gold charms across several teeth.

items.question: How much does access cost?
items.answer: Access to the Studio is €5 per month. There is no commitment: you can cancel at any time.

items.question: Is the Studio available on mobile?
items.answer: Yes. The Studio works on desktop, tablet and mobile; a larger screen is more comfortable for fine placement.

items.question: Can I save my compositions?
items.answer: Yes. Your compositions are saved in your personal gallery, so you can come back to them, duplicate them or keep refining them.

items.question: Can I use my creations when ordering jewellery?
items.answer: Your saved composition is a reference: share it with your artist, or use it to find the matching pieces in the shop.
